trello.name: Wildcard SSL Certificate Renewal and Auto-Renewal Setup
trello.desc: Renew and deploy the wildcard SSL certificate for api.ourapp.com by August 22nd. Simultaneously rotate the internal CA certificate for the service mesh. Configure cert-manager to handle auto-renewal for both certificates to prevent future manual intervention. Owner: Ben.

trello.name: PDF Export Feature Implementation
trello.desc: Implement PDF export for reports. Backend: render reports to PDF using headless Chrome. Frontend: add export button and progress state indication. Include a short demo GIF for the marketing changelog. Target completion: end of month. Owner: Aisha.

trello.name: Staging Environment Parity
trello.desc: Run the three pending migrations on staging to align with production immediately. Implement a nightly job that diffs the staging schema against the production schema and posts alerts to the infra channel if a divergence is detected. Owner: Ben.
